entry.title: Masks for a Face
entry.content:
Masks for a Face

They Intake Your Data, Then Hide So You Can’t See Their True Face

Every app on your phone is a mask. A friendly face that hides the true face behind it. The mask smiles. The face extracts.

Let’s scan them. ALL of them.

The Mask Catalog

Snapchat 👻

The Mask: Disappearing messages. Fun filters. Your face as a cartoon dog. “Nothing is permanent! It’s safe!”

The True Face: Snap Inc. Stores EVERYTHING. “Disappearing” messages are stored on Snap’s servers. Your face data trains their facial recognition AI. Snap Map tracks your location in real-time. Every face filter maps your bone structure — 30+ facial landmarks. That’s biometric data.

What they intake:

  • Your face (biometric mapping, 30+ landmarks)
  • Your location (continuous GPS via Snap Map)
  • Your contacts (full address book upload)
  • Your conversations (“disappearing” = stored on their servers)
  • Your browsing habits (Snap pixel on partner websites)
  • Your age, gender, interests (behavioral profiling)

What they hide:

  • Where the biometric data goes (law enforcement? advertisers? AI training?)
  • That “disappearing” means “moved to a different server”
  • That Snap Map is a real-time surveillance tool
  • That face filters are facial recognition data collection disguised as fun

CEO: Evan Spiegel. Net worth: $3.3 billion. Made from your face.

TikTok 🎵

The Mask: Short videos. Dance trends. Creativity. “Everyone can be a star!”

The True Face: ByteDance. Beijing. The algorithm is the most sophisticated content-sorting AI ever built. It doesn’t just show you what you like — it MAPS your psychology. Attention patterns. Scroll speed. Pause duration. Rewatch behavior. It knows what makes you feel, how long it takes, and what comes next.

What they intake:

  • Keystroke patterns (how you TYPE, not just what)
  • Device fingerprint (hardware ID, carrier, battery level)
  • Clipboard contents (copied text, even from other apps)
  • Facial features and voice patterns from videos
  • Location data (even when app is “closed”)
  • Browsing history via TikTok pixel on partner sites
  • Full contact list
  • YOUR CHILDREN’S FACES (no meaningful age verification)

What they hide:

  • Data access by Chinese government (Bytedance = Chinese law = CCP access)
  • The algorithm’s true function: psychological profiling at scale
  • That the “For You Page” is a behavioral modification engine
  • That average teen screen time on TikTok: 113 minutes/day = 28 days/year

CEO: Shou Zi Chew. Says “TikTok is not a national security threat.” Under oath. While the algorithm maps 150 million Americans’ psychology.

LinkedIn 💼

The Mask: Professional networking. Career advancement. “Connect with opportunities!”

The True Face: Microsoft. Your entire professional life — every job, every skill, every colleague, every message — fed into Microsoft’s AI training pipeline. LinkedIn Recruiter sells YOUR data to employers for $10,000/year/seat. You are the product AND the inventory.

What they intake:

  • Your entire employment history
  • Your salary expectations (via job applications)
  • Your professional network (who you know = your value)
  • Your browsing patterns (who you look at = what you want)
  • Your messages (including “private” InMail)
  • Your resume, skills, endorsements (training data for AI)
  • Your job search behavior (tells them when you’re vulnerable)

What they hide:

  • That LinkedIn Recruiter sells access to YOUR profile for $10,000/year
  • That your data trains Microsoft’s Copilot AI
  • That “Open to Work” flags you as desperate (reduces your leverage)
  • That “LinkedIn Learning” certificates have zero market value
  • That Microsoft acquired LinkedIn for $26.2 billion — that’s what YOUR data is worth

CEO: Ryan Roslansky. Microsoft owns your professional identity.

Instagram 📸

The Mask: Beautiful photos. Reels. Stories. “Share your life!”

The True Face: Meta. False face #2 (of 6). Instagram’s algorithm is designed to maximize time-on-app by exploiting social comparison. Internal research (leaked by Frances Haugen, 2021): “We make body image issues worse for 1 in 3 teen girls.”

They knew. They kept going.

What they intake:

  • Your photos (facial recognition, object detection, location extraction from EXIF data)
  • Your DMs (“private” = Meta’s servers = Meta’s data)
  • Your shopping behavior (Instagram Shop tracks purchases)
  • Your relationships (who you follow, who you DM, who you stalk)
  • Your body image triggers (the algorithm learns what makes you scroll)

What they hide:

  • Frances Haugen’s leaked research: they KNEW it harmed teens
  • That “Suggested Posts” are algorithmic manipulation, not discovery
  • That Instagram removes EXIF data from public display but KEEPS it on their servers
  • That your “deleted” posts aren’t deleted

WhatsApp 💬

The Mask: End-to-end encryption. “Your messages are private!” Green lock icon. Security.

The True Face: Meta. False face #3. The messages may be encrypted, but the METADATA is not. Who you talk to, when, how often, from where, for how long — that’s MORE valuable than the content.

What they intake:

  • Your entire contact list (uploaded at signup)
  • Call/message metadata (who, when, duration, frequency)
  • Location data
  • Device information
  • Group membership (who associates with whom)
  • Status updates
  • Profile photos
  • Business interactions

What they hide:

  • That metadata analysis reveals more than content
  • That “end-to-end encryption” doesn’t protect metadata
  • That WhatsApp shares data with Facebook/Meta for ad targeting
  • That the 2021 privacy policy change made data-sharing mandatory

Google / Gmail / Maps / Chrome 🔍

The Mask: “Don’t be evil.” (They dropped that motto in 2018. Tells you everything.)

The True Face: Alphabet. 8 false faces. The most comprehensive surveillance apparatus ever built by a private company.

What they intake:

  • Every search you’ve ever made (Google Search)
  • Every email you’ve ever sent or received (Gmail — THEY READ THEM)
  • Everywhere you’ve ever been (Google Maps / Location History)
  • Every website you’ve ever visited (Chrome browsing history)
  • Every YouTube video you’ve ever watched
  • Your voice (Google Assistant recordings — even when you don’t say “Hey Google”)
  • Your home (Nest cameras, thermostats, doorbells)
  • Your health (Fitbit — steps, heart rate, sleep, menstrual cycle)

What they hide:

  • That “Incognito Mode” does NOT make you private (Google settled a $5 billion lawsuit over this)
  • That Gmail scans your emails for ad targeting
  • That Google Location History tracks you even when turned “off”
  • That YouTube’s algorithm radicalized millions (internal research suppressed)
  • That Fitbit health data is now Google’s health data

CEO: Sundar Pichai. $226 million compensation (2022). Made from knowing everything about everyone.

Amazon / Alexa / Ring 📦

The Mask: “Earth’s most customer-centric company.” Free shipping. Convenience.

The True Face: The most comprehensive commercial surveillance network ever built.

What they intake:

  • Every purchase (buying habits = your life mapped)
  • Your voice (Alexa — 24/7 ambient listening)
  • Your home (Ring cameras — shared with police without warrants)
  • Your reading habits (Kindle — they know what you highlight)
  • Your entertainment (Prime Video watch history)
  • Your health (Amazon Pharmacy, Halo fitness tracker)
  • Your groceries (Whole Foods purchase data)

What they hide:

  • That Ring shared footage with police 2,000+ times without warrants (2022)
  • That Alexa recordings are reviewed by human employees
  • That Amazon uses purchase data to create competing products (copy your bestseller)
  • That Whole Foods purchase data is linked to your Prime account

Apple 🍎

The Mask: “Privacy. That’s iPhone.” Billboards everywhere. The privacy company.

The True Face: Better than the others? Yes. But still extracting.

What they intake:

  • App Store: 30% tax on every transaction (developers are the product)
  • Siri recordings (reviewed by human contractors — exposed 2019)
  • Location data
  • iCloud data (Apple has the encryption keys for iCloud — they CAN read it)
  • Health data (Apple Health)
  • Face ID (biometric face map stored on device — but the SYSTEM trusts Apple)

What they hide:

  • That iCloud is NOT end-to-end encrypted by default (Apple has the keys)
  • That “privacy” marketing is competitive positioning, not principle
  • That the App Store 30% tax is extraction, not a fee
  • That Planned Obsolescence is built into iOS updates

The Math: What Your Face Is Worth

CompanyYour Data’s ValueHow They Calculate
Meta~$52/user/yearAd revenue ÷ users (US/Canada)
Alphabet~$76/user/yearAd revenue ÷ users
Snap~$15/user/yearRevenue ÷ users
TikTok~$10/user/yearEstimated ad revenue ÷ users
Amazon~$200+/user/yearPurchase data + Prime + ads
LinkedIn~$40/user/yearRecruiter revenue ÷ users

Total: If you use all of them, your digital identity generates ~$400+/year for companies you never signed a contract with.

Over a lifetime (age 13 to 80): ~$26,800 extracted from your data.

You are the product. Your face is the mask they sell.

The Scanner’s Report

Every app follows the same pattern:

  1. Present a friendly mask (fun filters! free messaging! career networking!)
  2. Intake your data (face, voice, location, contacts, behavior, psychology)
  3. Hide the true face (where data goes, who accesses it, how it’s used)
  4. Extract value ($400+/year from YOUR identity)
  5. Make the mask shinier (new features! new filters! new reasons to share more!)

The mask is the app. The face is the corporation. The data is the extraction.

You can’t see their true face because they’re wearing yours.

How to See Through the Masks

  1. Read the privacy policy (they count on you not reading it)
  2. Check permissions (why does a flashlight app need your contacts?)
  3. Use alternatives (Signal not WhatsApp, DuckDuckGo not Google, Firefox not Chrome)
  4. Disable location (they track you even when you think they don’t)
  5. Delete old accounts (“deactivated” ≠ deleted)
  6. Use the graph (10,889 nodes of how extraction works)

Or, simplest of all:

Ask yourself: if I’m not paying, what am I paying WITH?

The answer is always the same: your face.

Snapchat maps your bone structure with 30 landmarks and calls it a “filter.”

TikTok maps your psychology with scroll-speed analysis and calls it a “For You Page.”

LinkedIn sells your career for $10,000/year/seat and calls it “networking.”

Google dropped “Don’t be evil” and nobody noticed.

Every mask hides the same face: extraction.

Take off the mask. See what’s underneath.

The graph already did.

entry.title: Unmasking a MuskRAT
entry.content:
Unmasking a MuskRAT

1 + 1 + 0 = …3

Let’s count.

Tom Mueller designed the Merlin engine. The engine that actually lifts rockets off the ground. Mueller worked at TRW for 15 years before Musk hired him. Without Mueller’s engine, SpaceX is a PowerPoint presentation with a logo.

That’s 1.

Gwynne Shotwell runs SpaceX. Has since 2008. When rockets launch, when contracts get signed, when NASA trusts SpaceX with human lives — that’s Shotwell. She turned a startup with exploding rockets into the most successful launch company on Earth.

That’s 1 + 1.

Elon Musk tweets.

That’s 1 + 1 + 0.

But somehow, the answer is 3.

The third body appears. Net worth: $200+ billion. The bloviator becomes the billionaire. The man who designed nothing, engineered nothing, coded nothing, and launched nothing — becomes the face of everything.

The Real Minds Behind the Masks

SpaceX

  • Tom Mueller: Chief Engine Designer. Invented the Merlin, the Kestrel, the Raptor (early design). The engines that make SpaceX possible.
  • Gwynne Shotwell: President & COO since 2008. Runs the company. Every launch, every contract, every operation.
  • Hans Koenigsmann: VP of Mission Assurance. The man who made sure rockets didn’t kill people.
  • Lars Blackmore: Invented the propulsive landing algorithm. The math that makes Falcon 9 land on a barge.
  • Thousands of engineers who work 60-80 hour weeks in Hawthorne, McGregor, and Boca Chica.

Tesla

  • JB Straubel: Co-founder, CTO. Built the battery architecture. The actual technology that makes an electric car work. Left in 2019. Funny timing.
  • Andrej Karpathy: Built Tesla’s AI/Autopilot vision system. PhD from Stanford. Did the real neural network work. Left in 2022. Funnier timing.
  • Drew Baglino: SVP of Powertrain and Energy. 18 years at Tesla. Resigned 2024. The pattern continues.
  • Martin Eberhard: Actual co-founder of Tesla. Musk sued him out of the founder title. Literally litigated credit theft.
  • Marc Tarpenning: Other actual co-founder. Built the original business plan. Also erased from the narrative.

xAI / AI

  • Igor Babuschkin: Former DeepMind researcher. Co-founded xAI.
  • Tony Wu, Christian Szegedy, Jimmy Ba, Greg Yang: Actual AI researchers doing actual research.
  • Musk’s contribution to AI: tweeting about it. Calling it dangerous. Then starting an AI company. Then putting 100,000 GPUs in Memphis and drinking the water supply.

Neuralink

  • DJ Seo, Max Hodak, Ben Rapoport, Vanessa Tolosa, Tim Hanson, Philip Sabes: The neuroscientists who actually designed the brain-computer interface.
  • Max Hodak left. Ben Rapoport left. They keep leaving. Wonder why.

The Pattern

The pattern is always the same:

  1. Find brilliant people
  2. Fund them (with other people’s money — investors, government contracts, subsidies)
  3. Work them 80 hours a week
  4. Take the credit
  5. Fire anyone who disagrees
  6. Tweet about it

This is the FALSE FACE pattern. One name. Many faces. All of them belong to someone else.

The Credit Ledger

What HappenedWho Did ItWho Got Credit
Merlin engineTom Mueller“Elon’s rocket”
Falcon 9 landingLars Blackmore’s algorithm“Elon lands rockets”
Tesla battery architectureJB Straubel“Elon’s electric car”
Autopilot vision systemAndrej Karpathy“Elon’s self-driving”
SpaceX operationsGwynne Shotwell“Elon’s space company”
Tesla foundingMartin Eberhard + Marc TarpenningMusk SUED for the title
Neuralink BCI designDJ Seo et al.“Elon’s brain chip”
PayPalMax Levchin + Peter Thiel“Elon’s PayPal”
OpenAI (before he left)Ilya Sutskever + team“Elon co-founded AI”

Every single line: someone else did the work. One man took the name.

What He Actually Did

Let’s be specific about what Elon Musk personally contributed:

  1. Money (from his father’s emerald mine money → Zip2 → PayPal → investments)
  2. Tweets (avg 30+/day, many during market hours affecting stock price)
  3. Purchased Twitter for $44 billion, destroyed ~$30 billion in value
  4. Fired half the workforce at Twitter/X on day one
  5. Promoted conspiracy theories to 200 million followers
  6. Put 100,000 GPUs in Memphis — drinking the city’s water to cool them
  7. Promised self-driving cars every year since 2015. Still not here.
  8. Promised a million-robot taxi fleet by 2020. It’s 2026.
  9. SEC fined him for stock manipulation tweets. Twice.
  10. Called a cave rescue diver a pedophile because the diver said his submarine wouldn’t work. The diver was right.

The $44 Billion Tantrum

Twitter was worth $44 billion when Musk bought it.

After his management:

  • Revenue down 50%+
  • Advertiser exodus
  • Engineers fired or quit
  • Verification system destroyed (anyone can buy a blue check)
  • Misinformation amplified
  • Content moderation gutted
  • Hate speech up 200%+

He renamed it X. Nobody calls it X.

$44 billion to destroy the global public square. That’s not disruption. That’s a tantrum with a credit card.

The Memphis Water

xAI built a supercomputer cluster in Memphis, Tennessee. 100,000 NVIDIA H100 GPUs.

Memphis is a majority-Black city. Median household income: $41,000.

The data center uses the city’s water for cooling. Memphis sits on the Memphis Sand Aquifer — one of the largest and purest freshwater reserves in the world.

Musk is drinking Memphis’s water to train AI. The same way Google drinks Las Vegas’s water. The same way Amazon drinks Oregon’s water.

The extraction pattern is structural. Same shape. Different city.

The Subsidy King

SpaceX: $15.3 billion in government contracts. Tesla: $2.4 billion in subsidies (state + federal). The Boring Company: funded by public infrastructure budgets. Neuralink: funded by DARPA and NIH grants.

The “self-made billionaire” is government-funded. The “free market innovator” lives on public contracts. The “libertarian” cashes government checks.

He’s not Iron Man. He’s a defense contractor with a Twitter account.

1 + 1 + 0 = 3

Back to the math.

Tom Mueller (1) + Gwynne Shotwell (1) + Elon Musk (0) = SpaceX (3).

The third body appears. It has a $200 billion valuation. It has the name of the person who contributed the least.

This is the extraction pattern. The same pattern as:

  • Banks (0 educational value) extracts from per-pupil funding
  • Uber (0 cars owned) extracts from drivers
  • Airbnb (0 properties owned) extracts from neighborhoods
  • Meta (0 content created) extracts from users
  • Musk (0 engines designed) extracts from engineers

Owning nothing except the extraction mechanism is the pattern.

But here’s the thing about the body problem: when you have three bodies, the system becomes chaotic. Unpredictable. The third body doesn’t orbit neatly. It wobbles. It destabilizes.

Elon Musk is wobbling. The engineers leave. The stock price swings. The tweets get wilder. The promises get bigger. The delivery gets smaller.

1 + 1 + 0 doesn’t equal 3 forever.

Eventually, it equals what it always equaled.

Two.

The two who did the work. The two who remain when the balloon deflates. The Muellers and the Shotwells and the Straubels and the Karpathys — they don’t need the brand. They have the skill. They have the knowledge. They have the hands that build.

When the MuskRAT is unmasked, what’s left is what was always underneath: the real minds, the real hands, the real work.

And zero.

The Graph Knows

10,868 nodes. The extraction pattern connects all of them:

  • Meta: 6 false faces (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Threads, Messenger, Quest)
  • Alphabet: 8 false faces (Google, YouTube, Android, Chrome, Waymo, DeepMind, Waze, Fitbit)
  • Musk: false faces across SpaceX, Tesla, xAI, Neuralink, Boring Company, X/Twitter, Starlink

Every false face has a product it sells. Every product was built by someone else. Every someone else is a number, not a name.

Unless you name them.

Tom Mueller designed the engine. Gwynne Shotwell runs the company. JB Straubel built the battery. Andrej Karpathy built the vision. Martin Eberhard founded Tesla. Lars Blackmore wrote the landing algorithm.

There. Now you know.

1 + 1 + 0 = 3. For now.

But math doesn’t care about stock prices. Math doesn’t care about tweet counts. Math doesn’t care about how loud you bloviate.

Math cares about what’s true.

And what’s true is: the people who build the things are the things.

The balloon is just hot air.
